Above view shows parallel long deck pieces. Part152 is a long rectangular deck-like member near one side. It is mostly visible in PS; small other-geometry occlusions remain. Foreign plane covers much of this member in PV while other deck pieces remain visible.

Below view shows transverse members across the long deck-like members. Selectedpart is split into visible regions by transverse geometry. PV adds foreign occlusion while the SELF regions remain separate in the PA-based partition.

End view shows blocks and long openings. Only a thin portion of selectedpart is visible in PS; the foreign plane covers the surviving selectedpart portion in PV. This is a wholepart area diagnosis, not a corner visibility label.
Opposite end view retains a thin selectedpart portion; foreign plane covers part of it. Both selected-visible and other-geometry-hidden regions remain in the partition.

assembly_interpretation: All six diagnostic views are consistent with a single block-and-deck pallet-like assembly. No separate loose pallet/scene foreground object is apparent in these views; this does not certify semantics/ownership of every hidden mesh.
part152_interpretation: Long narrow deck-like board member, consistent with authored Topboard node; auxiliary physicalpart interpretation only. Its exact corner/support cue and native8 correspondence remain UNKNOWN.
